title: Chapter 246: Subjugating Goode (Part 1)
content:
Chapter 246: Subjugating Goode (Part 1)

"Good, you can't use your sunset bow in this competition, do you have any objection?"

Wang Shuo came to the cell door and said with a smile.

Seeing Wang Shuo coming again, Gude stood up from the haystack and glanced at Wang Shuo contemptuously.

"Can I have an opinion?" He wanted to say something.

Then he frowned and looked confused.

After not seeing each other for a few days, how could this boy’s strength increase so quickly?

Gude felt something in his heart and did not dare to neglect it!

"Just give me an ordinary weapon." Good said lightly.

In a close-quarters competition, bows and arrows are indeed not very useful. In addition to bows and arrows, Gude can barely use other weapons.

"good."

Wang Shuo invited Gude to the school grounds.

The only people present were Gong Zheng and Ayub.

This is also just in case.

"What weapon do you want to use?" Wang Shuo unlocked the shackles on Gude's hands and feet and smiled at him.

"You used a gun, so I'll use a gun too!"

So, the two men held long guns and faced off 20 meters away.

Both of them held their breath, moved lightly, and adjusted their best offensive posture.

Suddenly, Wang Shuo took the lead and took the lead. The spear was like a winding spiritual snake, spinning in the air and heading straight towards the door facing Gu.

Gude was not to be outdone. Without any expression on his face, he held his spear and ran towards Wang Shuo, the tip of the spear dragging a long mark on the ground.

In the blink of an eye, he arrived first, and his sophisticated spear swiped at Wang Shuo's flame spear from the side.

"Bang"

The sound of the collision of gold and iron sounded.

Wang Shuo's spear tilted, but he did not panic. After all, Wang Shuo had experienced a lot of battles.

He then followed the direction in which the spear swung, and turned. After one rotation, the spear swept towards Goode again.

The blow was so powerful that Good had no choice but to stand up his spear to block it.

After a simple probing attack, Wang Shuo grinned: "I'm going to start exerting my strength!"

"Come here, if you have any tricks, I'll do it!" Gude also held the gun with both hands and swung the flame gun away again.

It can be seen that Gude played very conservatively and was far less liberal than Wang Shuo.

On the one hand, it was because he was not good at using spears, and on the other hand, as a prisoner, he was still somewhat intimidated.

Wang Shuo's face straightened up and he immediately launched a combo of attacks.

First came "Iron Rope Binding", then "Fire Breath", plus "Dragon Transformation Blow".

For these three skills, Wang Shuo has added internal strength to maximize the damage.

After receiving this blow, Goode's expression changed drastically.

He never thought that a mere little lord of level 31 could actually cause so much harm to him.

His entire body was knocked away and he fell to the ground, with his health points reduced by nearly half.

A surge of energy and blood surged up, his mouth felt sweet, and a mouthful of blood spurted out.

Gude's intestines are filled with regret. If he had known better, he wouldn't have pretended to be so big!

He swallowed back the blood that had not yet spewed out of his throat, quickly got up, and took a defensive posture.

Seeing this situation, Ayub felt even more troubled.

Is this still the Lord he knows?

Ayyub couldn't believe his eyes.

But Gong Zheng's eyes lit up and he became happy for Wang Shuo. Gong Zheng had a simple mind. The stronger the lord, the happier he would be.

At the same time, Goode no longer dared to rely on others and dealt with it seriously.

Although several of his skills require the use of bows and arrows to exert their maximum power.

But at any rate, internal strength can still be used on the spear, and at the same time, the "Eagle Eye" skill can still see clearly the opponent's moves.

He quickly used his skills and poured his internal energy into the spear.

The two fought together again.

Wang Shuo also felt the true strength of a senior general at this time.

"Dang, Dang"

The two spears collided together again, causing Wang Shuo's jaw to hurt.

The opponent's strength was far superior to Wang Shuo's. If Wang Shuo didn't have the equipment bonus, he would have been defeated long ago.

As time passed, Wang Shuo's skills could finally be used again.
